"""Exact C215286 reverse-crosswalk Native entrypoint and offline identity check."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

TARGETS = {"reverse_clear": "disjoint", "reverse_tangent": "contact", "reverse_overlap": "overlap"}
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def check(scene):
    if scene.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-113-2" or scene.get("cell_id") != "C215286":
        raise ValueError("wrong frozen law or cell")
    if scene.get("actor") != "motor_vehicle_driver":
        raise ValueError("wrong frozen actor")
    key = scene.get("case_id", "").split("__")[-1]
    if TARGETS.get(key) != scene.get("target_physical_relation"):
        raise ValueError("wrong exact case target")
    if scene.get("fps") != 20 or scene.get("camera_names") != list(VIEWS):
        raise ValueError("missing common four-camera capture plan")
    return {"case_id": scene["case_id"], "target": TARGETS[key],
            "native_source_packet_required": True, "physical_realization": "pending"}


def _copy(source, destination):
    target = Path(destination)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with target.open("xb") as stream, Path(source).open("rb") as original:
        shutil.copyfileobj(original, stream)


def _project(attempt, scene, packet):
    """Copy sealed acquisition to attempt root and derive original trace rows."""
    from crosswalk_delivery import measure

    root = Path(attempt)
    source = root / "capture"
    names = ("video_frames.jsonl", "reviewed-crosswalk-source.json",
             "original-site-packet.json", "original-site-source.json",
             "channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl")
    for name in names:
        _copy(source / name, root / name)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    context = json.loads((root / "reviewed-crosswalk-source.json").read_text())
    measured = measure(rows, source_id=context["source_id"],
                       map_sha256=packet["map_sha256"],
                       crosswalk_source=packet["crosswalk_source"],
                       vehicle_actor_id=context["vehicle_actor_id"])
    target = scene["target_physical_relation"]
    target_rows = [row for row in measured["frames"] if row["relation"] == target
                   and row["reverse_gear"] and row["reverse_speed_mps"] > .05]
    destination = packet["reverse_route_xy"][-1]
    distance = math.dist(rows[-1]["position_xy"], destination)
    trace = [{"frame": row["native_frame"], "time_s": row["time_s"],
              "position": {"x": row["position_xy"][0],
                           "y": row["position_xy"][1], "z": 0.0},
              "position_m": [*row["position_xy"], 0],
              "velocity_mps": row["velocity_mps"],
              "speed_mps": math.hypot(*row["velocity_mps"][:2]),
              "heading_deg": row["heading_deg"]} for row in rows]
    reverse = [{"frame": row["native_frame"], "time_s": row["time_s"],
                "body_vertices_m": row["body_vertices_m"],
                "heading_deg": row["heading_deg"],
                "velocity_mps": row["velocity_mps"]} for row in rows]
    for name, values in (("trace.jsonl", trace), ("reverse_history.jsonl", reverse)):
        with (root / name).open("x") as stream:
            for value in values:
                stream.write(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    (root / "crosswalk_context.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "map_sha256": packet["map_sha256"],
        "crosswalk_source": packet["crosswalk_source"],
        "crosswalk_polygon_xy": packet["crosswalk_polygon_xy"],
        "district_source": packet["district_source"],
        "highway_boundary_source": packet["highway_boundary_source"],
        "crosswalk_marking_source": packet["crosswalk_marking_source"]
    }, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    (root / "marked-crosswalk-source.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "marked_crosswalk_source": packet["crosswalk_source"],
        "map_sha256": packet["map_sha256"],
        "crosswalk_polygon_xy": packet["crosswalk_polygon_xy"]
    }, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    with (root / "reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl").open("x") as stream:
        for row, relation in zip(rows, measured["frames"]):
            stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"],
                                     "value": {"relation": relation["relation"],
                                               "body_polygon_xy": row["body_polygon_xy"],
                                               "crosswalk_polygon_xy": row["crosswalk_polygon_xy"],
                                               "reverse_gear": row["reverse_gear"],
                                               "reverse_speed_mps": relation["reverse_speed_mps"]}},
                                    sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return measured, target_rows, distance


def native(scene, output_dir, host, port):
    from carla_cameras import OriginalCameras
    from encode_original import encode
    from native_capture import capture
    from site_packet import check_world, read
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture, write_result
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot
    import carla

    checked = check(scene)
    site_path = os.environ.get("CROSSWALK_SITE_PACKET")
    if not site_path:
        raise ValueError("CROSSWALK_SITE_PACKET original reviewed site path required")
    packet, _, _ = read(site_path, checked["case_id"])
    root = Path(output_dir)
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("materialized attempt directory required")
    client = carla.Client(host, int(port))
    client.set_timeout(20)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    world = client.get_world()
    settings = world.get_settings()
    if not settings.synchronous_mode or abs(settings.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("dedicated Native world must run synchronously at 20 Hz")
    check_world(world, packet)
    cameras = None
    failure = None
    restoration = None
    try:
        cameras = OriginalCameras(world, carla, packet)
        capture_dir = root / "capture"
        capture_dir.mkdir()
        captured = capture(world, carla, site_path, checked["case_id"],
                           capture_dir, cameras.read)
    except BaseException as error:
        failure = error
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if cameras is not None:
                cameras.close()
        finally:
            restoration = restore(client, saved)
            if failure is not None:
                (root / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                    "errors": [type(failure).__name__ + ": " + str(failure)],
                    "restoration": restoration, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False
                }, indent=2) + "\n")
    encoded = encode(root, checked["case_id"])
    measured, target_rows, distance = _project(root, scene, packet)
    completion = distance <= .25
    target_check = {"target": "reverse_body_crosswalk_relation",
                    "requested": checked["target"],
                    "measured": {"target_original_frames": [row["frame"] for row in target_rows],
                                 "observed_relations": sorted({row["relation"] for row in measured["frames"]})},
                    "method": "source-hashed original 20 Hz reverse body and crossing polygon",
                    "tolerance": {"polygon_contact_m": 1e-8, "reverse_speed_mps": .05},
                    "matched": bool(target_rows), "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                    "cause_evidence": []}
    check_source = {"reverse_frames": captured["source_hashes"]["reverse_frames"]}
    checks = {"setup": {"status": "met", "method": "900 original frames and four source cameras",
                        "sources": {"site_packet": packet["map_sha256"]}, "intervals": []},
              "target": {"status": "met" if target_rows else "not_met",
                         "method": "original body/crossing polygon while backing",
                         "sources": check_source, "intervals": []},
              "maneuver": {"status": "met" if completion else "not_met",
                           "method": "original route endpoint distance",
                           "sources": check_source, "intervals": [],
                           "engineering_endpoint_radius_m": .25,
                           "endpoint_distance_m": distance}}
    result = {"case_id": checked["case_id"],
              "measured_values": {"original_frame_count": captured["frame_count"],
                                  "backing_target_frame_count": len(target_rows),
                                  "endpoint_distance_m": distance},
              "target_checks": [target_check], "physical_checks": checks,
              "setup_confirmed": True, "behavior_attempted": True,
              "maneuver_completed": completion,
              "termination_reason": "planned_900_frame_reverse_interval_completed",
              "physical_failure_flags": [name for name, failed in (
                  ("target_not_observed", not target_rows),
                  ("reverse_goal_not_reached", not completion)) if failed],
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": ["raw.mkv", *[name + ".mkv" for name in VIEWS]],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": json.loads((root / "construction.json").read_text())["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": [{"name": "reverse_body_crosswalk", "unit": "structured",
                                      "reference": "reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl"},
                                     {"name": "marked_crosswalk_source", "unit": "metadata",
                                      "reference": "marked-crosswalk-source.json"}],
              "realized_observables": {"reverse_body_crosswalk": {
                  "relations": [row["relation"] for row in measured["frames"]],
                  "original_source": "channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl"}},
              "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    (root / "acquisition-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
        "case_id": checked["case_id"],
        "site_source_sha256": captured["source_hashes"]["site_source"]
    }, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    write_result(root, result)
    seal_capture(root, frames=900, restoration=restoration, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in encoded["views"]},
                 context={"map_sha256": packet["map_sha256"],
                          "original_camera_identity": "video_frames.jsonl"})
    print(json.dumps({"case_id": checked["case_id"], "original_frames": 900,
                      "physical_target_met": bool(target_rows),
                      "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    scene = json.loads(Path("scene.json").read_text())
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(scene)))
    else:
        if not args.output_dir:
            parser.error("--output-dir required")
        native(scene, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Check an independently reviewed C215286 site packet before Native capture.

The worker does not invent a map polygon, district, or crossing station. The
operator supplies those original sources and this module rejects changed bytes.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from crosswalk_delivery import validate_source


VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def sha256(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _transform(entry):
    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not entry.get("source"):
        raise ValueError("independent transform source required")
    for key in ("xyz", "rpy"):
        values = entry.get(key)
        if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) != 3 or any(
            type(value) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(value)
            for value in values
        ):
            raise ValueError("finite sourced transform required: " + key)


def read(path, case_id):
    """Return a source-bound packet; source document must be a distinct file."""
    path = Path(path)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    packet = json.loads(raw)
    if packet.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("site packet exact case differs")
    source_path = Path(packet.get("site_source_path", ""))
    if not source_path.is_file() or source_path.resolve() == path.resolve():
        raise ValueError("independent original site document required")
    source_bytes = source_path.read_bytes()
    if sha256(source_bytes) != packet.get("site_source_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("original site document hash differs")
    source = json.loads(source_bytes)
    fields = (
        "map_name", "map_sha256", "crosswalk_source", "crosswalk_polygon_xy",
        "vehicle_blueprint_id", "spawn_transform_source", "reverse_route_xy",
        "driver_source", "district_source", "highway_boundary_source",
        "crosswalk_marking_source", "vehicle_class_source", "camera_transforms",
        "spawn_transform",
    )
    for field in fields:
        if packet.get(field) != source.get(field):
            raise ValueError("original site document differs: " + field)
    validate_source(packet)
    if not packet.get("highway_boundary_source") or not packet.get("crosswalk_marking_source") or not packet.get("vehicle_class_source"):
        raise ValueError("highway, marking, and vehicle classification sources required")
    _transform(packet.get("spawn_transform"))
    cameras = packet.get("camera_transforms")
    if not isinstance(cameras, dict) or set(cameras) != set(VIEWS):
        raise ValueError("four original camera station sources required")
    for entry in cameras.values():
        _transform(entry)
    return packet, raw, source_bytes


def check_world(world, packet):
    """Bind the site packet to the actual Native OpenDRIVE bytes."""
    map_object = world.get_map()
    if map_object.name != packet["map_name"]:
        raise ValueError("Native map identity differs from reviewed site")
    if sha256(map_object.to_opendrive().encode("utf-8")) != packet["map_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Native OpenDRIVE bytes differ from reviewed site")
    return packet["map_sha256"]


def verify_saved(root, context):
    """Reopen the two original source copies in a promoted saved attempt."""
    root = Path(root)
    packet_file = root / "original-site-packet.json"
    source_file = root / "original-site-source.json"
    if not packet_file.is_file() or not source_file.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: original site packet/document")
    packet_raw, source_raw = packet_file.read_bytes(), source_file.read_bytes()
    if (sha256(packet_raw) != context.get("original_site_packet_sha256") or
            sha256(source_raw) != context.get("original_site_source_sha256")):
        raise ValueError("saved original site source hash differs")
    packet, source = json.loads(packet_raw), json.loads(source_raw)
    if packet != context.get("map_packet") or sha256(source_raw) != packet.get("site_source_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("saved original site packet differs")
    for field in ("map_name", "map_sha256", "crosswalk_source", "crosswalk_polygon_xy",
                  "vehicle_blueprint_id", "spawn_transform_source", "reverse_route_xy",
                  "driver_source", "district_source", "highway_boundary_source",
                  "crosswalk_marking_source", "vehicle_class_source", "camera_transforms",
                  "spawn_transform"):
        if packet.get(field) != source.get(field):
            raise ValueError("saved original site document differs: " + field)
    validate_source(packet)
    return packet

"""Acquire original reverse motion and crossing geometry at 20 Hz.

The caller owns the Native world, actor and cameras. This code records originals
only; physical completion and pixels are checked independently after capture.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from crosswalk_delivery import construct, control_step, measure
from site_packet import check_world, read, VIEWS


HZ = 20


def _sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _hull(points):
    points = sorted(set((float(p.x), float(p.y)) for p in points))
    if len(points) < 3:
        raise ValueError("original body footprint has fewer than three vertices")

    def cross(o, a, b):
        return (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0])

    lower, upper = [], []
    for p in points:
        while len(lower) >= 2 and cross(lower[-2], lower[-1], p) <= 0:
            lower.pop()
        lower.append(p)
    for p in reversed(points):
        while len(upper) >= 2 and cross(upper[-2], upper[-1], p) <= 0:
            upper.pop()
        upper.append(p)
    hull = lower[:-1] + upper[:-1]
    if len(hull) < 3:
        raise ValueError("original body footprint is degenerate")
    return hull


def _write_once(path, data):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)
    return _sha(data)


def capture(world, carla, site_path, case_id, output_dir, camera_reader, *, frames=900):
    """Capture a full source-joined interval from an injected Native world."""
    if frames != 900:
        raise ValueError("exact 45 second original interval required")
    packet, packet_raw, source_raw = read(site_path, case_id)
    check_world(world, packet)
    root = Path(output_dir)
    if not root.is_dir() or any(root.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError("fresh empty capture directory required")
    spawn = packet["spawn_transform"]
    transform = carla.Transform(carla.Location(*spawn["xyz"]), carla.Rotation(*spawn["rpy"]))
    built = construct(world, packet, transform)
    ego = built["ego"]
    rows, mapping, cameras = [], [], {name: [] for name in VIEWS}
    first_native = None
    first_time = None
    camera_sensor_ids = None
    previous_position = None
    try:
        for index in range(frames):
            ego_transform = ego.get_transform()
            destination = packet["reverse_route_xy"][-1]
            location = ego_transform.location
            remaining = math.hypot(location.x - destination[0], location.y - destination[1])
            # The same route-endpoint controller applies to all three cases.
            control_step(ego, reverse=True, hold=remaining <= .25,
                         control_factory=carla.VehicleControl)
            native_frame = world.tick()
            snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
            if type(native_frame) is not int or snapshot.frame != native_frame:
                raise ValueError("original world frame/snapshot mismatch")
            now = float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
            if first_native is None:
                first_native, first_time = native_frame, now
            if native_frame != first_native + index or abs(now - first_time - index / HZ) > .003:
                raise ValueError("original 20 Hz time/frame join failed")
            current = ego.get_transform()
            position = (float(current.location.x), float(current.location.y))
            heading = float(current.rotation.yaw)
            if not math.isfinite(heading):
                raise ValueError("original heading readback invalid")
            if previous_position is not None and math.dist(position, previous_position) > 2:
                raise ValueError("implausible one-frame reverse displacement")
            previous_position = position
            velocity = ego.get_velocity()
            forward = current.get_forward_vector()
            vertices = ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(current)
            body = _hull(vertices)
            body_xyz = [[float(p.x), float(p.y), float(p.z)] for p in vertices]
            control = ego.get_control()
            if type(control.reverse) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("original reverse gear readback missing")
            observation = camera_reader(native_frame)
            if not isinstance(observation, dict) or set(observation) != set(VIEWS):
                raise ValueError("four original camera frames required")
            sensor_ids = {view: str(observation[view].get("source_sensor", "")) for view in VIEWS}
            if any(not value for value in sensor_ids.values()) or len(set(sensor_ids.values())) != len(VIEWS):
                raise ValueError("four distinct original camera sensors required")
            if camera_sensor_ids is None:
                camera_sensor_ids = sensor_ids
            if sensor_ids != camera_sensor_ids:
                raise ValueError("original camera sensor identity changed")
            camera_refs = {}
            for view in VIEWS:
                image = observation[view]
                if (type(image.get("frame")) is not int or image["frame"] != native_frame
                        or not image.get("source_sensor") or not isinstance(image.get("bytes"), bytes)
                        or not image["bytes"]):
                    raise ValueError("original camera source/frame mismatch: " + view)
                relative = f"cameras/{view}/{index:04d}.png"
                digest = _write_once(root / relative, image["bytes"])
                camera_refs[view] = {"path": relative, "sha256": digest,
                                     "source_sensor": str(image["source_sensor"])}
                cameras[view].append(camera_refs[view])
            mapping.append({"video_frame": index, "carla_frame": native_frame,
                            "native_frame": native_frame, "time_s": index / HZ,
                            "camera_sources": camera_refs})
            rows.append({"frame": index, "time_s": index / HZ,
                         "native_frame": native_frame, "vehicle_actor_id": int(ego.id),
                         "body_polygon_xy": body,
                         "crosswalk_polygon_xy": packet["crosswalk_polygon_xy"],
                         "velocity_xy": [float(velocity.x), float(velocity.y)],
                         "forward_xy": [float(forward.x), float(forward.y)],
                         "reverse_gear": control.reverse,
                         "position_xy": position, "heading_deg": heading,
                         "body_vertices_m": body_xyz,
                         "velocity_mps": [float(velocity.x), float(velocity.y), float(velocity.z)]})
        # Require actual reverse motion, but never infer a legal or physical target.
        measured = measure(rows, source_id=case_id + ":native:" + str(first_native),
                           map_sha256=packet["map_sha256"],
                           crosswalk_source=packet["crosswalk_source"],
                           vehicle_actor_id=int(ego.id))
        # A source edited while capture was running cannot silently acquire the
        # authority of the site review made before the first Native tick.
        _, final_packet_raw, final_source_raw = read(site_path, case_id)
        if final_packet_raw != packet_raw or final_source_raw != source_raw:
            raise ValueError("reviewed original site bytes changed during capture")
        frame_bytes = "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in rows).encode()
        frame_sha = _write_once(root / "channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl", frame_bytes)
        _write_once(root / "video_frames.jsonl",
                    "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in mapping).encode())
        _write_once(root / "original-site-packet.json", packet_raw)
        _write_once(root / "original-site-source.json", source_raw)
        context = {"source_id": measured["source_id"], "map_packet": packet,
                   "vehicle_actor_id": int(ego.id), "frames_sha256": frame_sha,
                   "original_site_packet_sha256": _sha(packet_raw),
                   "original_site_source_sha256": _sha(source_raw)}
        _write_once(root / "reviewed-crosswalk-source.json",
                    (json.dumps(context, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode())
        return {"case_id": case_id, "frame_count": frames,
                "native_first_frame": first_native,
                "native_last_frame": first_native + frames - 1,
                "source_hashes": {"site_packet": _sha(packet_raw),
                                  "site_source": _sha(source_raw),
                                  "reverse_frames": frame_sha},
                "camera_frames_per_view": {view: len(cameras[view]) for view in VIEWS},
                "physical_relation_status": "unreviewed",
                "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}
    finally:
        built["cleanup"]()

"""Losslessly encode source-checked Native camera frames and primary mosaic."""

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from carla_cameras import SIZES
from site_packet import VIEWS, verify_saved


def digest(path):
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            hasher.update(block)
    return hasher.hexdigest()


def _lines(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def validate_capture(capture, case_id, *, frames=900):
    """Reopen every original frame and station before invoking an encoder."""
    root = Path(capture)
    context_path = root / "reviewed-crosswalk-source.json"
    history_path = root / "channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl"
    mapping_path = root / "video_frames.jsonl"
    for path in (context_path, history_path, mapping_path):
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + str(path.relative_to(root)))
    context = json.loads(context_path.read_text())
    verify_saved(root, context)
    if context.get("source_id", "").split(":native:")[0] != case_id:
        raise ValueError("original capture exact case differs")
    if digest(history_path) != context.get("frames_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("original reverse frame bytes changed")
    rows, mapping = _lines(history_path), _lines(mapping_path)
    if len(rows) != frames or len(mapping) != frames:
        raise ValueError("complete original frame interval required")
    sensors = None
    for index, (row, frame) in enumerate(zip(rows, mapping)):
        native = frame.get("native_frame")
        if (row.get("frame") != index or frame.get("video_frame") != index
                or type(native) is not int or frame.get("carla_frame") != native
                or row.get("native_frame") != native or
                abs(row.get("time_s", -1) - index / 20) > .001 or
                abs(frame.get("time_s", -1) - index / 20) > .001):
            raise ValueError("original 20 Hz frame identity join differs")
        sources = frame.get("camera_sources", {})
        if set(sources) != set(VIEWS):
            raise ValueError("four original camera references missing")
        found = {name: sources[name].get("source_sensor") for name in VIEWS}
        if any(not value for value in found.values()) or len(set(found.values())) != len(VIEWS):
            raise ValueError("four distinct original camera sensors required")
        if sensors is None:
            sensors = found
        if sensors != found:
            raise ValueError("original camera sensor identity changed")
        for name in VIEWS:
            item = sources[name]
            expected = f"cameras/{name}/{index:04d}.png"
            path = root / expected
            if item.get("path") != expected or not path.is_file() or digest(path) != item.get("sha256"):
                raise ValueError("original camera bytes changed: " + name)
    return {"frames": frames, "map_sha256": context["map_packet"]["map_sha256"],
            "original_history_sha256": digest(history_path),
            "original_mapping_sha256": digest(mapping_path),
            "camera_sensors": sensors}


def _probe(path, frames, width, height, ffprobe):
    command = [ffprobe, "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
               "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames,r_frame_rate,codec_name,width,height",
               "-of", "json", str(path)]
    completed = subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    streams = json.loads(completed.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if len(streams) != 1:
        raise ValueError("single encoded video stream required")
    stream = streams[0]
    if (stream.get("nb_read_frames") != str(frames) or stream.get("r_frame_rate") != "20/1"
            or stream.get("codec_name") != "ffv1" or stream.get("width") != width
            or stream.get("height") != height):
        raise ValueError("full lossless video frame/rate/dimension readback differs")


def _decode(path, ffmpeg):
    command = [ffmpeg, "-v", "error", "-xerror", "-i", str(path),
               "-map", "0:v:0", "-f", "null", "-"]
    completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
    if completed.returncode:
        raise ValueError("full original video decode failed: " + completed.stderr[-500:])


def encode(attempt, case_id, *, frames=900, ffmpeg="ffmpeg", ffprobe="ffprobe"):
    root = Path(attempt)
    capture = root / "capture"
    checked = validate_capture(capture, case_id, frames=frames)
    encoded = {}
    for name in VIEWS:
        target = root / (name + ".mkv")
        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError("retain prior encoded original")
        pattern = capture / "cameras" / name / "%04d.png"
        command = [ffmpeg, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-nostdin",
                   "-framerate", "20", "-start_number", "0", "-i", str(pattern),
                   "-frames:v", str(frames), "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
                   "-pix_fmt", "bgr0", str(target)]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=900)
        _probe(target, frames, *SIZES[name], ffprobe)
        _decode(target, ffmpeg)
        encoded[name] = {"path": target.name, "sha256": digest(target),
                         "frames": frames, "fps": 20, "codec": "ffv1",
                         "source_sensor": checked["camera_sensors"][name]}
    primary = root / "raw.mkv"
    if primary.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior composed primary video")
    command = [ffmpeg, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-nostdin"]
    for name in VIEWS:
        command += ["-i", str(root / (name + ".mkv"))]
    command += ["-filter_complex",
                "[0:v][1:v][2:v][3:v]xstack=inputs=4:layout=960_0|0_1080|1280_1080|2560_1080:fill=black[v]",
                "-map", "[v]", "-frames:v", str(frames), "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
                "-pix_fmt", "bgr0", str(primary)]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=900)
    _probe(primary, frames, 3840, 1800, ffprobe)
    _decode(primary, ffmpeg)
    encoded["primary"] = {"path": primary.name, "sha256": digest(primary),
                          "frames": frames, "fps": 20, "codec": "ffv1",
                          "layout": "overview above three unscaled detail views"}
    index = {"format": "c215286-original-lossless-video", "case_id": case_id,
             "capture": checked, "views": encoded,
             "actual_pixels_reviewed": False, "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}
    with (root / "encoded-views.json").open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(index, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
    return index

"""Read original saved crosswalk frames without changing their bytes."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from crosswalk_delivery import audit, measure, validate_source
from site_packet import verify_saved

VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def measure_crosswalk(frames, source):
    """Measure the selected original body/crossing stream by source identity."""
    return measure(frames, source_id=source["source_id"],
                   map_sha256=source["map_packet"]["map_sha256"],
                   crosswalk_source=source["map_packet"]["crosswalk_source"],
                   vehicle_actor_id=source["vehicle_actor_id"])


def load_measured(attempt):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    context = attempt / "reviewed-crosswalk-source.json"
    frames_path = attempt / "channels" / "reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl"
    if not context.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: reviewed-crosswalk-source.json")
    if not frames_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl")
    source = json.loads(context.read_text())
    verify_saved(attempt, source)
    validate_source(source["map_packet"])
    actual_sha = hashlib.sha256(frames_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual_sha != source.get("frames_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("saved original frame hash differs")
    frames = [json.loads(line) for line in frames_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    if any(frame.get("crosswalk_polygon_xy") != source["map_packet"]["crosswalk_polygon_xy"]
           for frame in frames):
        raise ValueError("saved frame crosswalk differs from reviewed original map polygon")
    measured = measure_crosswalk(frames, source)
    return source, measured, actual_sha


def analyze(attempt, *, expected_relation):
    source, measured, actual_sha = load_measured(attempt)
    physical = audit(measured, expected_relation=expected_relation)
    root = Path(attempt)
    paths = ("channels/reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl", "reviewed-crosswalk-source.json",
             "original-site-packet.json", "original-site-source.json")
    hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in paths}
    return {"format": "worker-analysis-report",
            "measurements": {"crosswalk_relation": {
                "value": physical, "method": "measure_crosswalk", "sources": hashes}},
            "source_sha256": actual_sha, "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def write_result(attempt, report, expected_relation):
    """Rebuild a fresh result from saved source files, never trust a fixture result."""
    root = Path(attempt)
    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text())
    measured = report["measurements"]["crosswalk_relation"]["value"]
    target = {"target": "reverse_body_crosswalk_relation", "requested": expected_relation,
              "measured": measured, "method": "measure_crosswalk",
              "tolerance": {"polygon_contact_m": 1e-8, "reverse_speed_mps": .05},
              "matched": measured["observed_relation"] == expected_relation,
              "physical_cause_confirmed": False, "cause_evidence": []}
    result = {"case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
              "measured_values": {"crosswalk_relation": measured},
              "target_checks": [target], "setup_confirmed": False,
              "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "Saved original sources measured; legal judgment unresolved",
              "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": ["raw.mkv", *[view + ".mkv" for view in VIEWS]],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": config["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": [
                  {"name": "reverse_body_crosswalk", "unit": "structured",
                   "reference": "reverse-body-crosswalk.jsonl"},
                  {"name": "marked_crosswalk_source", "unit": "metadata",
                   "reference": "marked-crosswalk-source.json"}],
              "realized_observables": {}, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result
    result = physical_result(root, result)
    validate_result(result)
    (root / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    report.update(case_id=config["selected_case_id"],
                  physical_checks=result["physical_checks"],
                  realized_observables=result["realized_observables"],
                  provenance_kind=result["provenance_kind"],
                  diagnostic_fixture=result["diagnostic_fixture"],
                  analysis_complete=True,
                  limitations=["Physical source measurement only; legal judgment unresolved."])
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-relation", choices=("disjoint", "contact", "overlap"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads((Path(args.attempt) / "config.json").read_text())
    expected = config["case"]["target_physical_relation"]
    if args.expected_relation and args.expected_relation != expected:
        raise ValueError("requested analysis target differs from selected case")
    report = analyze(args.attempt, expected_relation=expected)
    write_result(args.attempt, report, expected)
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent physical comparison of two sealed reverse-crosswalk attempts.

The inputs are original saved frame streams and reviewed source packets. This
reports measured geometry only; it does not classify legal compliance.
"""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from analyze_source import load_measured
from crosswalk_delivery import audit, compare


PAIRS = {
    "reverse_contact_vs_clear": ("disjoint", "contact"),
    "reverse_overlap_vs_clear": ("disjoint", "overlap"),
}


def compare_attempts(left_attempt, right_attempt, *, comparison_id):
    if comparison_id not in PAIRS:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact comparison")
    if Path(left_attempt).resolve() == Path(right_attempt).resolve():
        raise ValueError("distinct saved attempts required")
    left_source, left, left_hash = load_measured(left_attempt)
    right_source, right, right_hash = load_measured(right_attempt)
    left_target, right_target = PAIRS[comparison_id]
    for key in ("map_name", "map_sha256", "crosswalk_source",
                "crosswalk_polygon_xy", "vehicle_blueprint_id", "driver_source",
                "district_source"):
        if left_source["map_packet"][key] != right_source["map_packet"][key]:
            raise ValueError("fixed source differs: " + key)
    if left["vehicle_actor_id"] != right["vehicle_actor_id"]:
        raise ValueError("fixed vehicle actor identity differs")
    if [r["time_s"] for r in left["frames"]] != [r["time_s"] for r in right["frames"]]:
        raise ValueError("comparison original times differ")
    audit(left, expected_relation=left_target)
    audit(right, expected_relation=right_target)
    physical = compare(left, right, changed_target=right_target)
    return {"comparison_id": comparison_id, "physical_comparison": physical,
            "original_frame_sha256": [left_hash, right_hash],
            "fixed_source_fields": ["map_name", "map_sha256", "crosswalk_source",
                                    "crosswalk_polygon_xy", "vehicle_blueprint_id",
                                    "driver_source", "district_source", "vehicle_actor_id",
                                    "frame_window", "time_window"],
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--left-attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--right-attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--comparison-id", choices=tuple(PAIRS), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = compare_attempts(args.left_attempt, args.right_attempt,
                              comparison_id=args.comparison_id)
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
